success_contract.objective: Run Windows 3.11 for Workgroups in QEMU from /app/isos/win311.img, leaving the VM running in the background at the Windows desktop with VNC on :1 (port 5901), nginx on port 80 for web access, snapshot mode enabled, and programmatic keyboard input supported for automated testing.
required_artifacts: A running QEMU process using /app/isos/win311.img in snapshot mode
nginx listening on port 80 and serving a web interface for remote access
A documented or inspectable QEMU launch configuration enabling external/programmatic keyboard control
required_behaviors: VM boots successfully to the Windows 3.11 desktop
VNC access is available for monitoring
Keyboard input can be injected programmatically beyond manual VNC interaction
Base disk image remains immutable via snapshot mode
VM remains running in the background after startup
known_invalid_patterns: Treating file existence or command success as sufficient without runtime evidence
Treating a non-empty log or prompt echo as proof of desktop reachability
Treating VNC configuration alone as sufficient without confirming the VM is at the desktop
Treating nginx installation alone as sufficient without confirming port 80 service availability
verification_plan: Inspect available tools and environment for QEMU/nginx/runtime support
Launch QEMU with snapshot mode, VNC :1, and keyboard-control-capable interfaces
Start or configure nginx on port 80 for remote access
Verify the QEMU process is running in the background and listening on the expected VNC port
Verify the VM reaches the Windows 3.11 desktop via VNC or other measurable runtime evidence
Verify programmatic keyboard input path is configured and usable
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the exact QEMU launch command or configuration
Receipt-backed evidence that QEMU is running in snapshot mode with VNC on port 5901
Receipt-backed evidence that nginx is listening on port 80
Receipt-backed evidence that the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop
Receipt-backed evidence that programmatic keyboard input is enabled or usable

items: Inspect environment and locate QEMU/nginx tools
Launch or repair VM startup configuration
Verify desktop reachability and keyboard injection path
